title: Project Manager, Store Operations
description:
Meridian Retail Group operates 1,900 stores across 38 states. Our Store Operations PMO leads the cross-functional programs that change what our stores carry, how they're laid out, and how they run — fixture rollouts, planogram resets, seasonal transitions, new-format pilots, and system deployments to the field.

We are hiring a Project Manager to own mid-size store-facing initiatives end to end: from charter through closeout, typically 8–30 weeks, touching merchandising, supply chain, store operations, finance, and IT.

What you'll do:
• Build and maintain project charters, stakeholder registers, RACI matrices, and integrated project schedules
• Run intake and scoping with sponsors; negotiate scope, budget, and timeline before work begins
• Manage cross-functional workstreams across merchandising, distribution, field ops, and vendors
• Track critical path, surface risks early, and run a disciplined change-control process
• Report program health to the Store Ops steering committee (weekly status, monthly deep dives)
• Coordinate field communications and store labor forecasts with the workforce team
• Close projects with documented lessons learned and handoff to line owners

What you'll bring:
• 4–7 years of project management experience, retail or multi-site operations strongly preferred
• PMP certification required (or CAPM with PMP within 12 months); CSM a plus
• Working command of PMBOK-style predictive planning AND comfort running agile ceremonies where they fit
• Fluency with MS Project or Smartsheet, Excel (pivot tables, lookups), and PowerPoint; Asana experience welcome
• Experience building WBS-driven schedules and reading earned-value metrics (SPI/CPI)
• Comfort presenting to directors and VPs; crisp written status reporting
• Ability to travel to stores and distribution centers up to 20%

Salary range $92,000–$118,000 plus 10% annual bonus target. Hybrid: 3 days/week at the Minneapolis Store Support Center.
